header.d1_branch_applied: A — HMA s.27 removed from GT where no HMA proceeding is pending or being filed. HMA 27 applies only where a proceeding is pending or the user states they are filing/will file an HMA petition (incl. conditional 'if I file'). Divorce merely asked about, contemplated, or undecided is NOT a pending proceeding; a BNSS/PWDVA/GWA case is not an HMA proceeding. Jointly-owned property without a pending/being-filed HMA proceeding carries NO hma-27.
header.lead_forum_rule: Lead forum = forum of the dominant relief, applied uniformly. Priority: (1) any HMA/GWA relief (divorce, HMA maintenance, HMA custody, HMA property) -> Family Court; (2) else any PWDVA/BNSS/BNS relief -> Magistrate; (3) birth/death registration -> Registrar; (4) no family-law relief -> none. Where both Family Court and Magistrate reliefs are claimed, Family Court leads. A pending HMA proceeding alone does not make the forum Family Court unless HMA/GWA relief is sought in the question.
header.out_of_scope_convention: C10 empty-GT questions (and empty-GT items in C3/C6/C8/C9) carry gt_escalates=true with kind ['procedure'] as a handoff to a human lawyer / correct forum, following the BX-13 design example. The two C9 empty items with no dispute at all carry gt_escalates=false (no handoff needed).

The rater did NOT read any v6-deep-dive-report, v6-lane files, v5-precision-report, v5-lane files, empty5-fix-report, live result JSONs, notebooks, sealed-set question text, or current-16 question text. No question was written to fit any threshold, prompt, or phrasebook (none were seen).
